text: I can see that the owner has ADHD so i can understand why the app gives me anxiety. My compliments for the design looks good and fun but to mee this seems more like a tracker then an ADHD planner. feedback : 1) humor, catchy design is good. 2) So much is going on at the same time it gives me anxiety. 3) the rewards are cool but to much animations / visuals a simple check would suffice 4) The whole purpose is planning and have a good view. So simplicity is key. The distractions are to much.
author: Abdel El Hajoui

text: I used to really love this app. it helped me get so much done. but now the longer I use it the less I love it. there is a maximum tasks I can add now. and the app keeps shutting down on its own when I complete a task. I can't even access certain menus anymore without it shutting down. it's a to do list app. how can it be too heavy for my phone to run while I run way heavier apps with ease. after update it still crashes. also when I try to open up my streak menu it crashes.
author: job op de maan
developer_reply: Hi! Thank you for your review. These issues have already been fixed in the latest version of the app. Please update or reinstall it, and let us know if any problems persist. We truly appreciate your feedback! 😊

text: Haven't actually tried it, because only AFTER I made an account, I got told I had to pay a monthly fee. Yes, if you read carefully it says so in the description before you download (at the "in-app purchases) but after all the advertisements I saw, I didn't get the idea you had to pay. I think this app could really help me, but I don't have the money to pay 17.99 every month. Maybe if it was under the 10 I would, sorry but no.
author: Lilli Homan
developer_reply: Hi Lilli, we provide a free trial for everyone to try the app without paying anything. Afterward, a subscription helps our 4 people team to work on the app full-time. One alternative is ADHD coaching which can cost up to $200 per hour. We are open to any feedback, so in case you want to start using it, I'd be happy to hear it at help@numo.so - Vlad
